operations.notes: Drawer and cupboard open, support 2 kg contents each, close, latch and resist finite pull challenges; 5 kg top cargo retained. Virtual key, finite point-hand actuation.
Both physical pedals engage wheel and swivel brakes, retain engagement after toe release, resist the declared 80 N handle challenge, and release.
Loaded low-speed rolling and steering followed by stopping, both parking brakes and released retention; finite handle force.
Continuous park, storage use and lock challenges, brake release, loaded roll/steer, stop/repark and repeated drawer use, with final released retention.
Native reset recovers body and control state and repeats a representative pedal sequence.
Clean-stage native reload recovers body and control state and repeats a representative pedal sequence.
Translated instance rotated 30 degrees repeats a cupboard open/close sequence with finite point forces.
Slow free ramp produces wheel rolling and relative travel, preserving attachment envelopes. Rolling onset is not a measured sliding-friction coefficient.

Direct joint-drive targets are not a supported user control interface. The embedded controller owns joint drive gains, force caps and position/velocity targets on every physics step, so external targets may be overwritten. Operate through physical forces at handles/pedals and the documented virtual-key attributes. Official generic joint_movement result: fail. Recorded watchdog timeouts are incomplete evidence and establish neither a joint-specific failure nor a pass; they do not prove physical impossibility. Completed everyday point-force operations are a separate positive claim. No general direct-drive compatibility is claimed.

assumptions: 66kg manufacturer unloaded mass; estimated material-weighted COM and inertia, contact properties and compliant lock/brake laws.
Rigid workshop floor; finite point-hand/toe actuation, not robot frictional grasp.
2kg drawer payload, 2kg shelf payload and 5kg top cargo are tested examples; 400kg capacity is not qualified.
Virtual key requests represent omitted key/lock internals; no pose/joint-state override during play.
limitations: Single-instance scope; two-copy campaign explicitly deferred by user.
Shelves fixed at delivered heights; no shelf adjustment, liquids, flexible cargo or high-speed towing.
No physical-sample calibration and no 400kg load certification.
